## What's Changed
* Added an option to set a default tab for the main "Apps" screen (https://github.com/omeritzics/Updatium/commit/06630d60d3587219a33c368f6769b5bdb5eab936).
* Moved Download/Update button's location to the buttom, as a FAB.
* Added an option to cancel ongoing downloads.
* Replaced the integration of the discontinued AppVerifier with AppVerifier BG (dbcf3f1c7d45f0091b7d549a34f7e4444fcc86ba).
* Fixed the bugs that appeared on Updatium 'Qama' v26.7 (#416).
* Removed Mullvad DNS provider, due to their announced discontinuation.
* Added the option to use an external installer (thanks to ObtainX project by @bikram-agarwal).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/omeritzics/Updatium/compare/Qama-v26.8...Qama-v26.9
